name: Hiroshima
tagline: Peace history and an island shrine
summary: Give Hiroshima’s peace history an unhurried day, then cross to Miyajima for tide-dependent shrine views and wooded temple paths. This is a worthwhile extension west from Osaka or Kyoto.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn suit walking. Summer is hot and humid; rain and tides affect Miyajima plans.
arrival: Arrive at Hiroshima Station by shinkansen or use an airport coach from Hiroshima Airport; the airport is outside the city.
gettingAround: Use trams, buses and walking for the central sights. Miyajima requires a rail/tram transfer to Miyajimaguchi and a ferry.
cashTip: Carry yen for small restaurants, shrine admission and local transport backups.
foodTip: Try layered Hiroshima okonomiyaki and Miyajimaguchi anagomeshi. Use the separately verified vegan and halal menus for dietary needs.
buyTip: Look for local lemon sweets, momiji manju and regional crafts; inspect ingredients on packaged sweets.
baseArea: Hiroshima Station for onward rail; Hondori / Peace Park for walkable evenings.
